envelope.description: Make the controller's verdicts phase use the service

body.title: Make the controller's verdicts phase use the service
body.summary: Make handleVerdicts async and give it the repository's LifecycleService; the review-step handler awaits it with the registry's service for the run's repository. An applied fix goes through updateContent, the meta.review stamp stays a meta-only write, and the review is applied on the lifecycle when the status allows one; migrate gate-review-fix.test.ts and the other tests of handleVerdicts with it.
acceptanceChecks: handleVerdicts with a service stores an applied fix through the service, stamps the review and records it on the lifecycle
a head that is ahead of its log is refused before anything is stamped
without a service handleVerdicts writes as before
the tests of handleVerdicts pass in their async forms

tests.name: verdicts-lifecycle.test.ts: handleVerdicts with a service stores an applied fix through the service, stamps the review and records it on the lifecycle, and refuses a head that is ahead of its log
